title: Design: Edit Vendor dropdown looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure vendor A is on Net 30.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p7-03-edit-vendor-today.png, ct-p7-04-edit-vendor-the-picker-with-your-terms.png, ct-p7-08-any-other-vendor-s-picker.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the vendor page of vendor A.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil on the vendor card.
  2. Click the "Credit Terms" box.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Edit Vendor" window opens (compare today's ct-p7-03-edit-vendor-today.png).

Step 2:

  • The list shows text-only rows in the same order as the customer dropdown.
  • "Net 30" is highlighted light blue with a blue tick before the name.
  • No row has a "Default" pill (as in ct-p7-04-edit-vendor-the-picker-with-your-terms.png).

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R1: “The Credit Terms dropdown on New Vendor and Edit Vendor lists the shop's active terms, standard and its own, in the S1-R5 order.”
  • S6-R2: “New Vendor starts on COD, as today. The shop's default does not apply to vendors, and the vendor dropdown shows no "Default" tag.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "7 Vendors" ("Edit Vendor today", "Edit Vendor: the picker with your terms", "Any other vendor's picker").
